evals.prompt: Using the approved avatar, recreate this creator's split-screen news short on a new robotics story from this month.
evals.expected_output: A BRIEF.md from the reference format, a sourced topic and 60-72 word script, a 1:1 talking-head take, official B-roll with provenance, and a split-screen render with STT-timed captions and badges.
assertions: Every number in the script appears in topic.md with at least two sources.
B-roll of the real product is acquired from official sources with URL, time range and SHA-256, and is never generated.
Captions are timed from speech_to_text words of the generated take.
The render is produced from edl.json with render_short.py.

evals.prompt: Do two different options in parallel: one faithful split-screen, one dynamic remix, each on a different real tech story.
evals.expected_output: Shared avatar assets and BRIEF.md approved in the main thread, one sub-agent per option with exclusive ownership of options/<x>/, one paid submission per take, and two rendered shorts plus a local viewer page served over http.
assertions: Each option agent writes only inside its own options/<x>/ folder.
Each take is submitted once and its job and task IDs are recorded before polling.
The remix option uses a 9:16 camera-beat take; the split-screen option may use 1:1.
Both renders are listed in viewer.html, which is served over http and not published.
